# Card

Container for a unit of content. surface is the default (layered gradient), glass for content over imagery, solid for dense UIs, gradient border for featured items. interactive adds hover lift.

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `card.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library and runs axe-core on the rendered output (contrast is checked at token level). Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
